## Sheet: Ab Training
Complete these 4x per week upon waking:,,
Exercise,Sets,Reps
Stomach Vacuums,4,20 seconds
,,
Complete this 2x per week:,,
Exercise,Sets,Reps
Hanging/Lying Leg Raises,3,12
Cable Crunch,3,15
Plank,3,60 sec each

## Sheet: Day 1
Rest Period: 90-180 seconds,,
Exercise,Sets,Reps
Stationary Bike,1,5 minutes
Incline DB Press,2,6-8 (1 top set. 1 back down set)
Flat Machine Press,2,8-10 (1 top set. 1 rest pause (20))
Pec Deck,1,20 total reps (rest pause set)
Lateral Raise,3,12-15

## Sheet: Day 2

Exercise,Sets,Reps

Walking Lunge,2,12 each
Standing Calf Raise,3,10-12
